summary: On Monday, October 12, 2026, Ahold Delhaize took systems offline after a cybersecurity incident on its network. Stop & Shop's website and app went down, and Hannaford, Giant Food and stores in the Netherlands and Belgium saw disruption to distribution centers, online orders and in-store pricing. The company refunded unfulfilled online orders and did not say whether data was taken.
